title: SpongeBob 2000 Years Later
blurb: SpongeBob's French Narrator is a straight parody of Jacques Cousteau's undersea documentaries, accent and reverent pacing included, and he is voiced by Tom Kenny, who also plays SpongeBob himself. His time cards became the show's most quoted running gag. This is the largest leap of the lot. Two thousand years, announced as calmly as one might say the following morning, over a title card that has been screenshotted several million times since. Use it for anything that has taken considerably longer than it had any business taking.
origin: The French Narrator's '2000 Years Later' time card from SpongeBob SquarePants.
